title: Body Elixir
short_description: Face-level body care for mature, melanated skin.
details:
A rich body emulsion designed to deeply hydrate, soothe, and support barrier comfort for mature, melanated skin from shoulders to legs.

NFE Body Elixir extends the Layered Care philosophy to the body. It addresses dryness, crepey-looking texture, uneven-looking tone, and daily comfort with the same formulation discipline as Face Elixir.

Body skin is not secondary. This is daily body care with editorial restraint and sensorial intention.
benefits: Deeply hydrates and helps skin feel cushioned and supple
Helps improve the look of dry, ashy-looking patches
Absorbs without a heavy or greasy finish
usage:
Daily Ritual:

After showering or bathing, while skin is still slightly damp, apply Body Elixir generously to arms, legs, torso, and any areas prone to dryness. Massage in circular motions until fully absorbed.

Targeted Care:

For extra-dry areas such as elbows, knees, or heels, apply a second layer and allow to fully absorb before dressing.

Pro Tip: Apply immediately after bathing to support hydration while the skin barrier feels most receptive.
ingredients_inci:
Key Actives:

  • Ceramides — Support the body's skin barrier
  • Glycerin — Provides deep, lasting hydration
  • Shea Butter — Nourishes and soothes dry-feeling skin
  • Jojoba Oil — Helps balance moisture with a skin-friendly feel
  • Botanical Extracts — Antioxidant and soothing properties

texture_scent_experience:
Texture

A rich, creamy emulsion that spreads easily across large areas without feeling heavy or sticky. The formula absorbs quickly, leaving skin feeling soft, supple, and never greasy, even in drier climates.

Scent

No fragrance or perfume added. Natural botanical extracts provide a subtle, clean note that complements your daily routine without overwhelming.

Experience

Transforms daily body care into a moment of nourishment. The formula works immediately to soothe dryness and continues to support barrier comfort throughout the day. With consistent use, skin feels smoother, more comfortable, and beautifully hydrated.
